checks.title: Checks
checks.badgeHint: Agents may ignore this skill until its SKILL.md is fixed.

code.frontmatter_missing: SKILL.md does not start with frontmatter (a block between two --- lines) giving its name and description.
code.frontmatter_invalid: The frontmatter is not valid YAML: {{reason}}
code.description_missing: The frontmatter has no description. Agents use it to decide when to use the skill.
code.name_format: The name “{{name}}” should use only lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens, and not start or end with a hyphen.
code.name_too_long: The name is {{length}} characters; the limit is {{max}}.
code.name_mismatch: The name “{{name}}” differs from the folder name “{{folder}}”. Some agents expect them to match.
code.description_too_long: The description is {{length}} characters; the limit is {{max}}.
code.compatibility_too_long: The compatibility note is {{length}} characters; the limit is {{max}}.
code.document_too_long: SKILL.md is {{lines}} lines. Keeping it under {{max}} and moving detail into other files is recommended.
code.broken_reference: SKILL.md links to {{path}}, which is not in the skill.
